phenotype_specificity.statement: Person-level: P43 has infant-onset fever with lymphadenopathy and HLH; P44 has adult-onset fever with severe neurological disease (lacunar infarction with leukoencephalopathy, seizures). Exclusion of other genes is not stated.

quotes.quote: Regarding phenotypes, in family 27, which carried the p.A773fs variant, the younger brother (patient 43) experienced recurrent episodes of fever and lymphadenopathy from 3 months of age, whereas the elder brother (patient 44) developed recurrent fevers and severe neurological symptoms in adulthood.
Patient 44 developed dysarthria and severe seizures, with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the head showing lacunar infarction with leukoencephalopathy.

segregation.statement: Two affected brothers both carry the variant. Parents' genotypes and unaffected relatives are not reported in the text.

quotes.quote: Regarding phenotypes, in family 27, which carried the p.A773fs variant, the younger brother (patient 43) experienced recurrent episodes of fever and lymphadenopathy from 3 months of age, whereas the elder brother (patient 44) developed recurrent fevers and severe neurological symptoms in adulthood.

functional.statement: No assay result for this specific variant is stated in the text of 40574834. The paper says newly identified variants were tested with an NF-kB reporter assay in A20-deficient HEK293 cells (construct) and shown in Figure 2, and that diagnosis required functional confirmation, but the figure's variant labels are not in the text available here. These quotes are cohort-level.

quotes.quote: The results of functional analyses of newly identified TNFAIP3 variants are shown in Figure 2 and Supplementary Figure 2.
The diagnosis of HA20 was confirmed via functional analysis of the TNFAIP3 variant.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Frameshift (2-nt deletion), predicted p.(Ala773GlnfsTer57) per the batch HGVS. The paper attributes the disease to heterozygous loss-of-function variants.

quotes.quote: A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is a hereditary autoinflammatory disease caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in the TNFAIP3 gene (1).
All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3, comprising a total of 35 distinct pathogenic variants.

concerns: P44's onset is given as 27 yr while his initial diagnosis is 'Juvenile lacunar infarction with leukoencephalopathy'; the text says his neurological symptoms began in adulthood.
Paper writes c.2317_2318delGC; the batch writes c.2317_2318del.
Survey tables only; no individual case narrative beyond one sentence.
notes_for_panel: Sibling pair with variable expression. Parental testing is not reported, so the sibling pair is the only segregation information.
